physical_form.shape: Tall cylindrical body with straight walls, no taper. Slightly rounded shoulders transitioning to a wide-mouth neck. Flat base.
physical_form.cap: Black plastic flip-top lid with a sport spout and carry loop. The lid has a textured grip ring around the base. A locking mechanism clips the spout closed.
physical_form.neck: Wide-mouth opening — approximately 2.5 inches (6 cm) diameter
physical_form.body: Opaque double-wall stainless steel with a powder-coated matte finish. The color is a warm gradient — deep burnt orange at the bottom transitioning to golden yellow-orange at the top near the shoulders. The gradient is smooth and continuous.
physical_form.base: Flat circular base with a rubberized non-slip pad
physical_form.handle: A braided paracord wrist loop attached to the lid carry loop. The paracord is orange and yellow, matching the bottle gradient. Cobra-knot weave pattern, approximately 3 inches in diameter.

body_bottom.description: Deep burnt orange at the base of the bottle

body_top.description: Warm golden yellow-orange at the top/shoulders

gradient_mid.description: Mid-tone orange in the center of the body where the gradient blends

cap.description: Matte black flip-top lid with textured grip

paracord.description: Orange and yellow braided paracord handle

rendering_instructions.camera_angle: Straight-on front view with very slight rotation (5-10 degrees) so the bottle has depth and the gradient is clearly visible across the body
rendering_instructions.camera_height: Eye level — camera centered on the middle of the bottle
rendering_instructions.lighting: Clean, bright commercial product photography lighting. Key light from upper right to highlight the metallic powder-coated finish. Fill light from left. Rim light on edges to define the cylindrical silhouette. The orange gradient should look warm and rich.
rendering_instructions.depth_of_field: Sharp focus on the entire bottle, softer background
rendering_instructions.surface: The bottle should appear upright and grounded — standing on a surface, not floating
rendering_instructions.condensation: Light condensation droplets on the outside of the bottle to convey cold refreshment. Beaded water on the surface, not dripping.
rendering_instructions.reflection: Subtle reflection/shadow beneath the bottle for grounding

prompt_templates.base: A single insulated stainless steel water bottle, 32oz. Warm sunset gradient — deep burnt orange at the base blending to golden yellow-orange at the top. Matte powder-coated finish. Black flip-top sport lid with textured grip. Orange and yellow braided paracord wrist loop attached to the lid. Light condensation on the surface. Premium commercial product photography.

style_suffixes.splash: Dramatic water splash erupting around the bottle, dynamic liquid motion, droplets frozen mid-air, clean studio background
style_suffixes.outdoor: Bright sunlight, natural hiking/camping setting, active lifestyle energy
style_suffixes.minimal_studio: Clean seamless background, dramatic product lighting, studio quality
style_suffixes.athletic: Dynamic sports environment, motion energy, active lifestyle
